summary.text: Mark Lawrence is a Democratic member of the Maine Senate for Senate District 35, which covers Eliot, Kittery, Ogunquit, South Berwick and York in York County.
The Senate page lists Mark Lawrence as chair of the Energy, Utilities, and Technology committee.

paragraphs.text: The page lists Senate service in the 116th through 119th and 129th through 132nd Legislatures and prior service in the House in the 114th, 115th and 128th Legislatures.
Committee assignments listed: Energy, Utilities, and Technology (chair); Senate Conduct and Ethics.
